name: Aoife Gallagher
bio: Aoife Gallagher's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during a university project focused on aerodynamics. Captivated by the intricate dance of engineering and competition, she quickly traded textbooks for trackside observation. After graduation, she honed her skills through various roles, from data analysis to race strategy, always gravitating towards leadership positions. Aoife believes in fostering a collaborative environment where innovation thrives, and every team member feels empowered to contribute their best. Her calm demeanor under pressure, coupled with a relentless pursuit of performance gains, sets her apart.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back in a low ponytail during races.
physical.description: Aoife has a slender build and a thoughtful expression, often seen with a slight smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a pot of strong Irish tea available in the garage at all times.
